manifest.name: Research Hub
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Rebrands CardSpoke as a research-focused tool with a custom menu item for research stats

css: #plugin-research-stats { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(40,40,60,0.95); color: #ccc; padding: 6px 16px; font-size: 12px; font-family: monospace; z-index: 9998; display: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(100,100,200,0.3); } #plugin-research-stats.visible { display: flex; gap: 24px; justify-content: center; } #plugin-research-stats .stat-item { display: inline-block; } #plugin-research-stats .stat-value { color: #7cacf8; font-weight: bold; }
